text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went to the movie theater with 
Shinko Windy, she stopped in her tracks in 
front of a poster.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Ohh! Look! The main character in 
this anime is a wolf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Wolves are so cool! Their fangs gleam, 
and they'll bite into any beast, no matter 
what!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides! In picture books and fairy tales, 
wolves are always the villains!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fidgeting, waiting to see what evil deed 
will happen next, you just can't look 
away! That is the kind of master villain I 
am!
choice_data_list:
You like them because they're the villain, 
huh.

You like them because they're the villain, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And he's a worldwide badass, after all. 
The whole world is glued to the wolf.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, I'm sure this movie will plunge 
everyone watching straight into the depths 
of horror...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hey, watch this with me! Wahahaha—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't accept this!! Why is the wolf a 
good guy?!
choice_data_list:
*sniff*... That was a really heartwarming 
movie.

*sniff*... That was such a heartwarming 
movie, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you go crying tears of joy on me! 
Be more terrified, darn itttt!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was just not the case; it was a 
heartwarming movie about a kind-hearted 
wolf living peacefully alongside 
herbivores.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gugigi...! Wolves need to have way more 
evil charisma than this!
choice_data_list: There must be wolves that aren't evil too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Shut uuup! A mere minion talking about 
wolves is a million light-years too 
early!!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'm going to someone who actually 
understands! Windy-chan is definitely not 
in the wrong here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, that is that. You tell them how 
scary wolves are too!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I know not. In the first place, why 
come to me regarding a wolf?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai said it, that Brian is a 
solitary, lone wolf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're always chomping down on 
meat! You totally understand wolves, 
without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm not putting up with this.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Don't you ignore Windy-chan! 
Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop, don't bite me. ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know what goes through a wolf's 
head, but it probably doesn't think of 
itself as a hero or some kind of 
charismatic villain."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, what makes a wolf a wolf is 
its sheer fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Always hone your fangs and sink them into 
your prey. It's that wildness that makes a 
wolf a wolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. For example, wasn't there a scene 
like that in a movie?
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, they were fighting 
for their friends.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! That scene really got me hyped 
up too, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Baring its magnificent fangs at a beast 
bigger than itself! Nghhh...! That's it, a 
wolf's gotta have that kind of guts!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You've got quite a bit of potential! From 
now on, I might just let you in on some 
wolf talk once in a while, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fine by me. ...Good grief, you sure teamed 
up with an odd one, didn't you?
choice_data_list:
Thanks to that, I never get bored spending 
time with you.

I never thought she'd be this obsessed 
with wolves...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha, that's right! Windy-chan is 
amazing-nodan!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...So you're not denying that you're 
weird.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"You still have a long way to go too! From 
now on, the three of us will deepen our 
understanding of wolves!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, don't count me in.
